name: Snooze Screensaver
description: While an alarm rings, a black screen shows the time, the snooze count and a hint. A tap or a hardware key snoozes; while snoozed the screen stays and shows when the alarm rings again. Holding the screen or a stop key for a moment stops the alarm. Right after a snooze inputs are ignored for a short pause. Counts and limits snoozes and says a short text after each step. Works without Home Assistant; speech uses KS's alarm voice or, with its own volume, a Home Assistant action. Needs the Clock or Weather Mood screensaver with Let alarms take over: KS's own alarm screen covers plugin overlays.
author: d3rb3rt

settings.title: Snooze label
settings.description: The big text on the ringing screen.

settings.title: Show the time
settings.description: Shows the current time above the snooze label.

settings.title: Maximum snoozes
settings.description: 0 means unlimited. The last allowed snooze says so; after it a tap no longer snoozes and the alarm rings on until it is held to stop.

settings.title: Hold to stop
settings.description: How long the screen or a stop key must be held to stop the alarm, while it rings or is snoozed. A short tap only snoozes while it rings.

settings.title: Pause after snooze
settings.description: Every touch and key is ignored this long after a snooze, so a second finger or a quick second tap does nothing.

settings.title: Snooze keys
settings.description: Keys that snooze with a short press while the alarm rings (Android names without KEYCODE_, comma-separated). Empty: no key snoozes.

settings.title: Stop keys
settings.description: Keys that stop the alarm when held for the hold time, while it rings or is snoozed. A short press never stops. Empty: no key stops. Turn on KS's option to swallow the volume keys if they should not change the volume.

settings.title: Hint text
settings.description: Shown below the label while the alarm rings. - shows none. While snoozed the screen shows when the alarm rings again and how to stop it.

settings.title: Language
settings.description: Language of the default texts. Auto follows the device (German or English, otherwise English). Fields that still hold a default text switch with it; your own texts stay.

settings.title: Speech through
settings.description: KS alarm voice is local, with a volume per text (KS 2026.11.31 or newer). Home Assistant uses the action below instead and needs HA to be up.

settings.title: Home Assistant speak action
settings.description: As domain.action, e.g. this kiosk's esphome.<name>_announce (Developer tools > Actions, type announce). Only with Speech through Home Assistant.

settings.title: Extra action data (JSON)
settings.description: More fields for the action; the text goes as "message". Empty fits a kiosk announce action.

settings.title: Text on snooze (tap)
settings.description: Said after a snooze. - for silence. Placeholders: {n} this snooze, {total} minutes so far, {length} one snooze, {max} the limit, {time} now, {until} next ring.

settings.title: Volume of snooze text
settings.description: Percent of the alarm volume with the KS alarm voice (needs KS 2026.11.31, else alarm volume). With Home Assistant: announce volume. 0 changes nothing.

settings.title: Text on stop (hold)
settings.description: Said after the plugin stops the alarm. - for silence. Placeholders: {n} this snooze, {total} minutes so far, {length} one snooze, {max} the limit, {time} now, {until} next ring.

settings.title: Volume of stop text
settings.description: Percent of the alarm volume with the KS alarm voice (needs KS 2026.11.31, else alarm volume). With Home Assistant: announce volume. 0 changes nothing.

settings.title: Text on last snooze
settings.description: Said on the last allowed snooze. - for silence. Placeholders: {n} this snooze, {total} minutes so far, {length} one snooze, {max} the limit, {time} now, {until} next ring.

settings.title: Volume of last snooze text
settings.description: Percent of the alarm volume with the KS alarm voice (needs KS 2026.11.31, else alarm volume). With Home Assistant: announce volume. 0 changes nothing.
